attributes.label: Care Instructions
attributes.value: Avoid moisture and perfumes; store safely after each wear

source.quotedPhrase: To preserve its radiant shine and delicate finish, we recommend keeping it away from moisture and perfumes, and storing it safely after each wear.

sourceNotes.rawContent: Elevate your glamour with this stunning silver-toned tennis bracelet, featuring a brilliant solitaire centerpiece. This high-fashion statement piece adds instant sparkle to any outfit. To preserve its radiant shine and delicate finish, we recommend keeping it away from moisture and perfumes, and storing it safely after each wear.
